# `aitbc gpu-onchain list`

List all GPUs registered on the blockchain, optionally filtered by status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status (active, deactivated) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu-onchain list
```
